d: Enchanting melodies and soul-stirring lyrics converge in this mesmerizing romantic song, brought to life by the velvety vocals of Arijit Singh. Crafted by the musical genius Vivian Richard, with heartfelt words penned by Juno, this composition is a symphony of emotions that transcends time. The music video, directed by the visionary team at Dharma Productions, stars the captivating duo Tanya Maniktala and Danesh Razvi, capturing the essence of love through evocative visuals and tender moments. Arijit's emotive delivery, Vivian's enchanting composition, and Juno's poignant lyrics together…
